    "Short description": "Enjoy dabbing with the Leaf Buddi Limited Edition Wuukah Vaporizer, an electric rig fit with a 3200mAh battery power.     "Description": "Stocking Tru Dose Nicotine Pouches in your store is an excellent way to provide customers with a premium, smoke-free nicotine solution that is gaining traction among users seeking convenience and discretion. Tru Dose Nicotine Pouches are specifically designed to meet these needs, offering an enjoyable, convenient, and effective way to experience nicotine without the drawbacks of smoking or vaping.\n\\n\n\\nNicotine pouches are small, discreet, and easy to use. Unlike traditional cigarettes or vaping devices, they do not produce smoke, vapor, or odor, making them ideal for people who prefer a low-profile way to consume nicotine. Stocking Tru Dose Nicotine Pouches in your store gives your customers the convenience they desire without compromising on quality.\n\\n\n\\nWhat sets Tru Dose Nicotine Pouches apart from other options on the market is their commitment to quality and variety. This product not only appeals to smokers looking to quit but also to individuals who have already made the switch from smoking or vaping and are searching for a reliable nicotine solution. Nicotine pouches are a rapidly expanding market segment, and Tru Dose offers a premium option that meets the needs of a broad audience.\n\\n\n\\nFurthermore, adding nicotine pouches to your inventory helps to position your store as a forward-thinking retailer that understands and adapts to evolving consumer demands. Customers are increasingly looking for innovative products that fit seamlessly into their lifestyles, and nicotine pouches offer the perfect blend of discretion, convenience, and satisfaction.     "ID": "1135",

    "Name": "Brass Knuckles 650mAh Adjustable Battery",
    "Published": "1",
    "Visibility in catalog": "visible",
    "Description": "<div class=\"woocommerce-tabs wc-tabs-wrapper\" data-mce-fragment=\"1\">\n\\n<div id=\"tab-description\" class=\"woocommerce-Tabs-panel woocommerce-Tabs-panel--description panel entry-content wc-tab\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-title-description\" data-mce-fragment=\"1\">\n\\n<ul data-mce-fragment=\"1\">\n\\n \t<li data-mce-fragment=\"1\">The Brass Knuckles 650mAh battery in Gold or Silver is as compact as it is stunning. The battery itself is only 95mm in length, and 14mm in diameter. We have absolutely no idea how Brass Knuckles managed to fit such a long lasting 900mAh cell into such a small frame. Long gone are the days of the 300mAh herbal vaporizer batteries. All Brass Knuckles batteries are built with aesthetics and functionality in mind. All features are toggled through the conveniently sized power button. In order to turn the device on, simply press the button 5 times. If you’d like to swap to a more intense vaping experience, press the button 3 times to cycle between the three different voltage settings. The LED indicator on the outside of the button will keep let you know which setting you’re on. Blue is the lowest settings (3.2V), offering a relatively lax vaping experience, yellow (3.7V) is the middle-ground, and red (4.1V) is the maximum power setting.The Brass Knuckles 900 mAh battery uses a 510 connection, which makes it compatible with all 510 cartridges. To charge the device, screw on the USB charger. Once you attach your cartridge and select your power setting, hold down the power button while you inhale to kickstart your journey.This 100% Authentic Brass Knuckles Battery comes with:<br data-mce-fragment=\"1\" />1x – Brass Knuckles 650mAh Battery<br data-mce-fragment=\"1\" />1x – Brass Knuckles 510 Threaded USB Charger</li>\n\\n</ul>\n\\n</div>\n\\n</div>\n\\n<section class=\"related products\" data-mce-fragment=\"1\"></section>",

    "Description": "Discover the next evolution in botanical vaping with the Herbal Connection Blue Lotus 2G Cartridge – a premium option for customers seeking a smooth, aromatic experience with a touch of ancient herbal mystique. This 5-pack of 2-gram cartridges offers excellent value for retailers and resellers, combining high-end formulation with reliable performance that customers can count on.\n\\n\n\\nThe star ingredient in this formulation is Blue Lotus, a flower historically revered for its relaxing and euphoric effects. When paired with a high-quality hemp-derived extract, the result is a unique cartridge that provides both flavor and function. Users report a gentle sense of calm, clarity, and relaxation without any overpowering effects, making it a great option for both daytime and evening use.\n\\n\n\\nWhat sets this product apart is the inclusion of THCA, a non-psychoactive cannabinoid that converts to THC when heated. As a naturally occurring compound in raw cannabis, THCA is gaining attention for its potential wellness properties and smooth transition into a psychoactive experience when vaped or smoked. The combination of Blue Lotus and THCA makes this cartridge an intriguing and well-rounded product that appeals to both wellness-minded consumers and recreational users alike.\n\\n\n\\nEach cartridge is crafted for quality—utilizing clean extraction methods, premium hardware, and consistent formulation to ensure every hit is flavorful and effective. The 2-gram size means fewer cartridge swaps and more sustained use, which is ideal for high-volume customers.\n\\n\n\\nPerfect for vape shops, dispensaries, and hemp retailers, the Herbal Connection Blue Lotus 2G Cartridge | 5PK is an excellent wholesale addition to your inventory.     "Name": "iMINI PEN 1 380MAH 10W BATTERY",
    "Published": "-1",
    "Visibility in catalog": "visible",
    "Description": "<table border=\"0\" width=\"100%\" cellspacing=\"0\" cellpadding=\"0\" data-mce-fragment=\"1\">\n\\n<tbody data-mce-fragment=\"1\">\n\\n<tr data-mce-fragment=\"1\">\n\\n<td data-mce-fragment=\"1\">\n\\n<div id=\"ProductDetail_ProductDetails_div\" data-mce-fragment=\"1\"><span id=\"product_description\" data-mce-fragment=\"1\">Designed specifically for use with CBD, wax, and<b data-mce-fragment=\"1\"> concentrate cartridges</b>, the <b data-mce-fragment=\"1\">DTranscend</b> iMini Pen 1 vape pen is a high quality pen battery whose simple appearance belies a suite of features designed to take on even the thickest of concentrates. Constructed of premium stainless steel, the iMini Pen 1 CBD vape pen battery features a single button method of operation that makes it incredibly easy to use. Capable of firing at three different voltage levels with a max power output of 10W, the iMini Pen 1 implements a preheat function designed to slightly warm your concentrate, allowing for vaping even the thickest oils. An LED battery indicator ring around the firing button displays the current battery level and selected voltage level in an intuitive fashion, while a Micro USB port allows the iMini CBD vape pen to be charged anywhere you go. A step up from eGo style vape pen batteries, the DTranscend Pen 1 <b data-mce-fragment=\"1\">alternative vape pen</b> has been designed from the ground up to provide excellent performance no matter what concentrate cartridge you are using.<br data-mce-fragment=\"1\" /></span></div>\n\\n<div data-mce-fragment=\"1\"></div>\n\\n<div data-mce-fragment=\"1\"><span data-mce-fragment=\"1\"><span data-mce-fragment=\"1\"><b>DTranscend iMini Pen 1 CBD Vape Pen Features</b>\n\\n</span></span>\n\\n<ul>\n\\n \t<li><b></b>Stainless steel construction</li>\n\\n \t<li>Max power output: 10W</li>\n\\n \t<li>Voltage output: 3.7-4.2V</li>\n\\n \t<li>Three voltage output levels</li>\n\\n \t<li>Preheat function</li>\n\\n \t<li>Single button operation</li>\n\\n \t<li>Micro USB charging port</li>\n\\n \t<li>LED battery indicator</li>\n\\n \t<li>510 connection</li>\n\\n</ul>\n\\n<span data-mce-fragment=\"1\"><span data-mce-fragment=\"1\"><b>\n\\nIncludes</b>\n\\n</span></span>\n\\n<ul>\n\\n \t<li>1x DTranscend iMini Pen 1 CBD and concentrate vape pen</li>\n\\n \t<li>1x Micro USB cable</li>\n\\n \t<li>1x User manual</li>\n\\n</ul>\n\\n</div></td>\n\\n</tr>\n\\n</tbody>\n\\n</table>",

    "ID": "12110",

    "Name": "Combo Scale 700g x 0.01 & Kit",
    "Published": "1",
    "Visibility in catalog": "visible",
    "Short description": "This Combo Scale and Kit combines multi feature smoking needs into one. A wide tray side to make rolling simple and two raised tabs can be used to hold pre-rolls or a lighter. Once combusted, Astro Eight HTE Pre-Rolls deliver an enhanced entourage effect thanks to their <strong data-start=\"785\" data-end=\"818\">high terpene extract infusion</strong>, which amplifies the flavor and potency of each hit.</p>\n\\n<p data-start=\"875\" data-end=\"1394\">For smoke shop owners, carrying <strong data-start=\"907\" data-end=\"925\">THCA wholesale</strong> options like Astro Eight’s pre-rolls can attract more customers looking for top-tier alternatives to traditional cannabis.     "Name": "Roor Tech 14” Bubbler Smokey",
    "Published": "1",

    "Description": "<table class=\"colors_descriptionbox\" border=\"0\" width=\"100%\" cellspacing=\"0\" cellpadding=\"0\">\n\\n<tbody>\n\\n<tr>\n\\n<td valign=\"top\" width=\"100%\">\n\\n<table border=\"0\" width=\"100%\" cellspacing=\"0\" cellpadding=\"0\">\n\\n<tbody>\n\\n<tr>\n\\n<td>\n\\n<div id=\"ProductDetail_ProductDetails_div\"><b>U-Key Box V Pro by Leaf Buddi - Portable \"Key\" Battery\n\\n</b>\n\\nThe U-Key Box V Pro by Leaf Buddi features a portable \"key\" shaped battery design that is designed to be discreet and lightweight.     "Description": "Stocking <strong>Lucy nicotine pouches</strong> in your store is a smart way to provide a modern, smoke-free nicotine option that’s designed to appeal to a broad range of customers. With a variety of flavors and nicotine strengths, Lucy nicotine pouches offer something for everyone. The flavors are crafted to be enjoyable without overwhelming, delivering a balanced experience that fits seamlessly into any lifestyle. And for customers interested in a little extra burst of flavor, <strong>Lucy Breakers</strong> offer a unique twist, with an innovative design that lets users \"break\" a flavor bead inside the pouch to release a fresh taste whenever they desire. This feature adds an extra layer of customization, making <strong>Lucy Breakers</strong> a standout choice.\n\\n\n\\nBy stocking Lucy nicotine pouches, you’re providing your customers with a smoke-free, easy-to-use nicotine solution that aligns with their busy lives.     "Description": "Crave’s New Premium THC-A Pre-Rolls: Elevate Your Smoke Session\n\\nCrave is back at it again, raising the bar with their latest innovation—premium indoor THC-A flower pre-rolls. Each 0.5-gram pre-roll is expertly crafted using premium indoor-grown THC-A flower and coated in crystallized diamond, ensuring a potent and flavorful hit every time. Crave’s THC-A pre-rolls eliminate the hassle, providing a ready-to-smoke option that’s ideal for both experienced users and those new to cannabis. At 0.5 grams per pre-roll, these are the perfect size for a solo session or a quick break without waste.\n\\n\n\\nPremium Quality &amp; Freshness Guaranteed\n\\nCrave takes freshness seriously. Their THC-A pre-rolls come in a child-proof, seal-proof jar, designed to lock in freshness and preserve potency. This airtight packaging ensures that every pre-roll maintains its quality, flavor, and aroma until you're ready to enjoy it. Whether you keep it on your shelf or take it on the go, your Crave pre-rolls will always be as fresh as the day they were packed.\n\\n\n\\nWhy Choose Crave THC-A Pre-Rolls?\n\\n✔ Premium Indoor Flower – Grown to perfection for superior potency and flavor.\n\\n✔ Coated in Crystallized Diamond – Enhanced potency and a smooth smoking experience.\n\\n✔ Convenience &amp; Portability – No rolling, no mess—just light up and enjoy.\n\\n✔ Freshness Guaranteed – Child-proof, seal-proof jar keeps pre-rolls fresh.\n\\n\n\\nExperience Crave’s new THC-A pre-rolls and elevate your smoke session with premium quality and effortless convenience.     "Description": "<div class=\"flex max-w-full flex-col flex-grow\">\n\\n<div class=\"min-h-8 text-message flex w-full flex-col items-end gap-2 whitespace-normal break-words text-start [.text-message+&amp;]:mt-5\" dir=\"auto\" data-message-author-role=\"assistant\" data-message-id=\"77e3fe11-f6c6-4ef2-899a-08f61f9ae4e3\" data-message-model-slug=\"gpt-4o\">\n\\n<div class=\"flex w-full flex-col gap-1 empty:hidden first:pt-[3px]\">\n\\n<div class=\"markdown prose w-full break-words dark:prose-invert light\">\n\\n\n\\n<strong>Experience Wellness with Truemoola’s Micro Magic Mushroom Gummies</strong>\n\\n\n\\nTruemoola’s Micro Magic Mushroom Gummies provide a delightful and convenient way to incorporate microdosing into your daily routine. These gummies are carefully crafted to offer a consistent and controlled experience, making them ideal for those exploring the benefits of functional mushrooms. Whether you’re seeking enhanced focus, creativity, or a greater sense of well-being, Truemoola’s gummies are the perfect companion for mindful living.\n\\n\n\\nUnlike traditional methods, these gummies offer a precise dose in a flavorful, easy-to-enjoy form. Each gummy is expertly formulated with natural ingredients to ensure a consistent experience, eliminating the guesswork often associated with microdosing. Designed for convenience, they fit seamlessly into your lifestyle, whether you’re on the go, working, or relaxing at home.\n\\n\n\\nFor those who prefer variety, Truemoola also offers a range of other innovative mushroom products, including their popular <strong>mushroom bar</strong>. The mushroom bar is another fantastic option for enjoying the benefits of functional mushrooms, providing a rich, indulgent experience that perfectly complements the Micro Magic Gummies. Together, these products offer diverse ways to explore the potential of mushrooms while enjoying exceptional flavor and quality.\n\\n\n\\nIncorporating microdosing into your routine has never been easier. With Truemoola’s Micro Magic Mushroom Gummies, you can start your journey toward improved mental clarity, reduced stress, and a greater sense of balance. Each gummy is a step toward unlocking the natural benefits of mushrooms, allowing you to enjoy life with renewed focus and positivity.\n\\n\n\\nWhether you’re new to microdosing or an experienced enthusiast, Truemoola’s Micro Magic Mushroom Gummies and the <strong>mushroom bar</strong> are here to elevate your wellness journey.     "Description": "The <strong>Geek Bar Pulse Disposable Vape</strong> is a standout choice for vaping enthusiasts looking for a combination of power, performance, and convenience. With its impressive 650mAh battery, this disposable vape is built to last, offering extended use without the need for constant recharging. The device features a spacious 16mL e-liquid tank, making it ideal for users who want a long-lasting, hassle-free vaping experience. Whether you're on the go or just prefer a low-maintenance option, the <strong>Geek Bar Pulse</strong> is designed to deliver.\n\\n\n\\nOne of the key features of the <strong>Geek Bar Pulse</strong> is its innovative dual mesh coil design. This advanced technology allows for better heat distribution, which in turn produces richer, more flavorful vapor with every puff. Whether you enjoy fruity, dessert, or menthol flavors, the <strong>Geek Bar Pulse</strong> ensures that every draw is smooth and satisfying. With the capability to deliver between 7,500 to an astounding 15,000 puffs per device, this vape stands out in the crowded disposable market.\n\\n\n\\nThe <strong>Geek Bar Pulse</strong> is not just about longevity—it’s also about quality. The dual mesh coils help to preserve the flavor of your e-liquid, ensuring that you get the most out of every hit. The combination of the large battery and tank means that this vape will easily outlast many competitors, making it a cost-effective option for regular users. If you're someone who vapes throughout the day, the <strong>Geek Bar Pulse</strong> ensures that you won’t need to worry about running out of power or e-liquid anytime soon.\n\\n\n\\nIn addition to its impressive performance, the <strong>Geek Bar Pulse</strong> also has a sleek, modern design. It’s compact enough to fit comfortably in your pocket or bag, yet powerful enough to meet the needs of even the most demanding vapers. For those looking for a durable, high-quality disposable vape, the <strong>Geek Bar Pulse</strong> is the perfect choice. Whether you're new to vaping or a seasoned enthusiast, this device delivers on both flavor and performance, ensuring a premium vaping experience from start to finish.\n\\n\n\\nFor <strong>Geek Bar</strong> <strong>Disposable Distribution</strong> inquiries feel free to contact us at <strong>(617)-943-2040</strong> or email us at <strong>info@sigdistro.com</strong>",
